headline: Suzano Reports R$2.1 Billion Net Profit for Q3 2026
summary: Suzano reported a net profit of R$2.1 billion for the third quarter of 2026, a 6% increase compared to the same period last year. The company's adjusted EBITDA reached R$5.7 billion, reflecting a 9% annual growth.
why: Suzano is the world's largest producer of eucalyptus pulp, making its financial performance a key indicator for the global paper and pulp market.
